verdict.rationale: SolidJS explicitly documents streaming SSR and progressive hydration as first-class features ('full SSR and serverless support, with streaming and progressive hydration to get to interactive as quickly as possible') alongside Suspense for async data during streaming. Community evidence corroborates general performance/speed claims but doesn't specifically validate streaming SSR hands-on. missing for 10: independent hands-on report specifically testing/validating streaming SSR behavior, benchmark data on perceived load improvements from streaming.
